What is Wix?

Wix is one of the world’s most popular website builders, powering over 200 million websites globally. With its intuitive drag-and-drop editor, professional templates, and extensive app market, Wix makes it easy for anyone to create a stunning online presence.

Key Features

Drag-and-Drop Editor

Wix’s editor is legendary for its flexibility:

  • True drag-and-drop - Place elements anywhere
  • Pixel-perfect control - No rigid grids
  • Mobile editor - Customize mobile separately
  • Undo/redo - Experiment fearlessly

500+ Professional Templates

Start with a beautiful foundation:

  • Industry-specific designs
  • Fully customizable
  • Mobile-responsive
  • Regular updates

Wix App Market

Extend your site with 300+ apps:

  • E-commerce - Sell products online
  • Bookings - Appointment scheduling
  • Events - Ticket sales and management
  • Blog - Content marketing tools
  • Forms - Lead capture and surveys

SEO Tools

Built-in optimization features:

  • Custom meta tags
  • Automatic sitemaps
  • 301 redirects
  • Google Search Console integration
  • SEO wizard for beginners

Pricing

Wix offers several plans:

Plan Price Best For
Free $0 Testing and personal projects
Combo $16/mo Personal websites
Unlimited $22/mo Entrepreneurs and freelancers
Pro $27/mo Complete online branding
VIP $45/mo Priority support
Business Basic $27/mo Online stores
Business Unlimited $32/mo Growing businesses
Business VIP $59/mo Established businesses

Who is Wix For?

Wix is ideal for:

  • Small businesses needing an online presence
  • Freelancers showcasing their portfolio
  • Restaurants with online ordering
  • Service providers with booking needs
  • E-commerce stores of all sizes
  • Bloggers and content creators

Pros and Cons

Pros

  • ✓ Incredibly easy to use
  • ✓ Beautiful template library
  • ✓ Extensive app marketplace
  • ✓ Strong SEO features
  • ✓ Reliable hosting included
  • ✓ 24/7 customer support

Cons

  • ✗ Can’t switch templates after launch
  • ✗ Slower than static site generators
  • ✗ Higher plans can be expensive
  • ✗ Limited code customization

Wix vs Competitors

Feature Wix Squarespace WordPress
Ease of Use ★★★★★ ★★★★ ★★★
Templates 500+ 100+ 10,000+
Apps/Plugins 300+ 30+ 50,000+
E-commerce Yes Yes Yes
Blogging Good Excellent Excellent
SEO Good Good Excellent
Price $16-59/mo $16-49/mo Free + hosting

The Verdict

Rating: 4.5/5 stars

Wix is an excellent choice for anyone who wants a professional website without the complexity of coding or WordPress. Its drag-and-drop editor is the most intuitive in the market, and the template library ensures you’ll look professional from day one.

For small businesses, freelancers, and anyone who values ease-of-use over maximum customization, Wix is hard to beat.

Getting Started with Wix

  1. Sign up free at wix.com
  2. Choose a template that matches your industry
  3. Customize with the drag-and-drop editor
  4. Add content - text, images, videos
  5. Connect your domain (optional on free plan)
  6. Publish and share with the world
